text:
maya: ok team — finalizing the run-of-show for the workshop webinar next Wed. want to lock speaker lanes, rehearsal windows, and fallback demo plan

dan: timeline pls — we should confirm rehearsal slots for hosts + demos by EOD

maya: high level: 45m total, 25m content (2 short demos), 15m hands-on workshop with breakout prompts, 5m close + CTA

eli: that works. i can host and do one demo. who owns the advanced demo?

sam: i’ll take advanced demo (model routing + cost/latency tradeoffs). nina can do the UI walkthrough with me in the second slot

nina: yep, will prepare 3 slides + live demo deck. need a 15m dry run with mic check + screen share check

maya: rehearsal plan:
```
- Tue 10:00am — tech check (hosts + ops)
- Tue 11:00am — full run (speakers + host) 45m
- Wed 9:00am — quick 15m warmup (just-in-case)
```

dan: ops roles:
- stream lead: @dan
- stage mgr (cueing slides): @nina
- demo fallback: @sam
- chat/Q triage: @maya + @eli

ops-bot: RECORDING_ENABLED: true 

maya: fallback demo options if live model fails:
- 1) switch to pre-recorded demo video (30s cut of advanced demo)
- 2) fallback to smaller local model on dedicated instance (same prompts)
- 3) show static screenshots + annotated logs

eli: important: we need a short pre-recorded clip for each demo (20-40s) ready and uploaded to cloud so ops can switch instantly

sam: uploading to GCS confirmed — path: (shared privately)

nina: design assets: slide master + two callout PNGs for the hands-on exercise. will drop in folder by EOD Mon

maya: registration + lead routing notes:
- add hidden field "workshop_track" on sign-up form with values: "beginner", "advanced"
- UTM: campaign=workshop_may2026, source=email/linkedin
- post-webinar flow: beginner -> product-nurture sequence, advanced -> SDR outreach + invite to pilot program

dan: SDR routing rule: if workshop_track==advanced AND attended==true then tag sdr_queue: "pilot-interest"

eli: how are we measuring success? KPIs: live attendees, avg watch time, demo conversion (trial signups within 7 days)

maya: yep, also want qualitative: chat engagement, number of workshop submissions, NPS on feedback form

nina: quick note on slides: please avoid heavy colors on code blocks; we need readable contrast for video compression

maya: run-of-show (minute-by-minute) draft:
```
0:00-0:03 — intro + housekeeping (eli)
0:03-0:08 — product narrative + why cost/latency matter (maya)
0:08-0:20 — demo 1: UI walkthrough (nina + sam)
0:20-0:25 — demo 2: advanced routing & fallback (sam)
0:25-0:40 — hands-on workshop prompt + breakout instructions (eli)
0:40-0:44 — panel quick takeaways (maya, sam, eli)
0:44-0:45 — close + CTA (signups, resources link)
```

dan: breakout logistics: we’ll use 4 rooms, auto-assign by track, ops to seed each with starter prompt + helper doc

ops-bot: BREAKOUT_ROOMS_CREATED: 4

eli: moderators for rooms? we need 4 helpers (can be SWE interns or AE). @maya can recruit two, @sam can ask one eng oncall

maya: i’ll ping growth for a helper and post in #help channel for volunteer moderators

sam: engineering will provide a lightweight CLI snippet for the workshop prompts. will be in repo under docs/workshops/

nina: can someone confirm we have permission for recording and reuse in the registration copy? legal ok?

maya: legal already flagged re-use; we have consent checkbox on registration. we’ll surface replay as "recorded session" only after attendee opt-in

eli: rehearsal etiquette: start with cameras on, headphones, quiet environment. ops to mute/unmute speakers during transitions

dan: final checklist for Tue run:
- slide deck final by Mon noon
- pre-recorded clips uploaded by Mon 5pm
- registration page updated with hidden field by Mon 3pm
- rehearsal invites sent now

maya: tagging tasks: @nina — slides + assets; @sam — pre-record clip + CLI snippet; @eli — host notes + opening script; @dan — ops checklist and stream key (send privately)

nina: acked 

sam: acked 

eli: who’s writing the workshop prompt set? want 3 tiers (quick, intermediate, stretch)

maya: i’ll draft prompts and share for review by Mon morning

ops-bot: DEPLOY_ALERT: no deploys to prod during live webinar window (Wed 2:00-3:00pm UTC)

maya: last Q — post-webinar cadence: send replay + resources at t+1h, automated NPS at t+48h, SDR follow-ups at t+72h for pilot leads

dan: all good. sending calendar invites now. :thumbsup:
